gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_spel: Learning needs one matching elemental fragment and one matching school fragment, both of the spell's grade. Intermediate and advanced arcane spells use an arcane fragment of that grade instead of an element fragment.

New targeted spells reach 16 blocks: right-click to select, left-click to confirm. Aim away for self-buffs.
Prisons and stuns stop movement, attacks, item use and casting. Tinnitus blocks casting and slows movement by 30%.
Listed values are base values. Equipment, attributes, battle qi and elemental reactions still apply.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_ligh: Glimmer: 1.5s, 20 mana, target 16. Night vision, glowing and level-10 lights within eight blocks for 60s.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_soun: Musical Inspiration is a basic blessing spell: two-second cast, 25 mana, target range 16 blocks.
The target gains Speed II, Haste I and Strength I for 20 seconds. Selecting empty space targets yourself.
Shattering Sound is intermediate destruction: four-second cast, 115 mana, 60-degree cone, range 10.
It deals 20 sound damage, pushes enemies two blocks and inflicts six seconds of tinnitus.
Tinnitus prevents casting, interrupts spell preparation, slows movement by 30% and increases sound damage taken by 30%.
New offensive spells do not harm their caster, allied team members or their caster's own summons.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_adva: Multi-Barrier Ray: advanced arcane damage, 2s cast, 100 mana, 8s cooldown, no target selection - barriers unfold in front of you.
The first barrier is covered by the base cost; hold Alt and left-click to add barriers for 150 mana each, up to nine, arranged in a ring without overlapping.
Each barrier lasts 15s, fires the moment it appears, then turns to the nearest enemy every 3s; 50 block range, 32 arcane damage per shot, pierces up to 5 targets.
Each hit also has a 10% chance to drain 1% of the target's max mana and deal extra damage equal to 1.25% of its max health.
Target priority: the creature you last attacked, then hostile mobs, then the nearest ordinary target.
Learning needs 1 advanced arcane and 1 advanced destruction fragment. New advanced spells grant +192 insight first, then +144 each.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.tiers.li: The mod uses two scales: spells are basic, intermediate or advanced, while fragments, crystals and staffs come as lesser, intermediate, advanced, supreme or special.
The spell page lists tiers from top to bottom, basic on top; the unlock fragments must match the spell's own tier.

A basic spell takes 1 lesser element fragment and 1 lesser school fragment; intermediate and advanced swap both for the matching tier. Intermediate and advanced arcane spells use an arcane fragment of the same tier.

Arcane has no element medium: intermediate and advanced arcane spells take a medium or advanced arcane fragment instead of an element fragment; the school fragment still matches the spell's school and tier.
Supreme and special spells are not implemented yet; those fragment tiers currently only serve processor upgrades and Ancient Stele research.
Element, school and arcane fragments all have these five tiers and can be upgraded one step at a time at the Crystal Processor.
Spell tier is not magic level: the first grades a single spell, the second is character growth from 0 to 15.
You start learning only after the fragments are paid; the cost is taken when learning begins and every later successful cast adds one point of progress.
While learning, each cast has a 40% chance to count, plus 20% per earlier success; a failed roll fizzles that cast but still costs mana and cooldown.
Three successes fully master the spell, granting 800 magic experience and putting it into a free hotbar slot.
Every newly mastered spell grants permanent base mana. Forgetting and relearning the same spell cannot award insight twice.
Basic insight: +48 for the first spell of that tier, then +24 for every new basic spell; intermediate: +96 then +64.
Advanced insight gives +192 for the first advanced spell, then +144 for every new one. First intermediate and advanced insights grant advancements.
Insight is permanent through element resets and Repentance Stones; mastered spells remain marked to prevent duplicate rewards.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_ice_: New Ice Spells: Frost Golem and Sub-zero Domain
Frost Golem: intermediate summon, 3s cast, 110 mana, 22s cooldown. Summons a translucent ice golem with a pumpkin head at your feet for 120s.
It has 35 health and the same movement speed as a snow golem, and never melees. Every 3s it fires an ice spike (7 ice damage and slow) at a visible enemy within 16 blocks.
After 10 spikes it shatters into ice crystals. Each player can have at most 4; the 5th evicts the one that expires first.
Sub-zero Domain: advanced control, 9s cast, 155 mana, 45s cooldown. When the cast finishes, one advanced ice sigil appears around you.
While it is active, hold Alt and left-click to stack layers (144 mana each, up to 12) at -60% movement speed. Press cast again to release; it releases automatically after 30s.
Release deals 55 ice damage in radius 12. Each layer multiplies damage by 1.18, adds 2 radius, +18% guaranteed-freeze health limit, +8% freeze duration, +3% damage taken and +7% reaction damage.
Enemies below the health limit are deeply frozen for 20s; enemies above the limit are frozen as well, but for half the duration. Frozen targets refresh their ice attachment every 4s.
While deeply frozen, all damage taken is +25% (+3% per layer) and elemental reaction damage is +35% (+7% per layer). Four direct attacks from the caster, a player or a mob break the freeze.
Inside the domain water becomes blue ice, lava becomes basalt and exposed blocks are covered with snow. The terrain conversion is spread over several ticks to avoid lag.
Frost Golem needs intermediate ice/summon fragments; Sub-zero Domain needs advanced ice/control. New intermediate insight is +96 then +64; advanced +192 then +144.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_thun: New Lightning Spells: Volt State and Rolling Thunder
Volt State: intermediate movement, 2.5 s cast, 120 mana, 30 s cooldown. Lightning wraps your body and a live circuit ring appears under your feet.

For 12 seconds you gain +200% movement speed, +50% jump height and take 50% less damage; every 0.5 s enemies touching you take 10 lightning damage and lightning attachment, ignoring invulnerability frames.
Learning needs 1 intermediate lightning and 1 intermediate movement fragment; new intermediate spells grant +96 insight first, then +64 each.
Rolling Thunder: advanced debuff, 15 s cast, 550 mana, 120 s cooldown. Sigil rings and a spinning ball lightning form above your head while casting.

The ball follows you for 30 seconds and strikes up to three random enemies within 9 blocks every 0.4 s for 8 lightning damage with attachment, ignoring armour, spell resistance and invulnerability frames; each hit leaves a 1 s lightning afterimage.
Every strike has a 55% chance to inflict 15 s Polarity Disorder (25% chance to refresh on later hits): +34% damage taken, no invulnerability frames, -42% damage dealt.
Hold Alt + left click while casting to add lightning balls for 555 mana each, up to two; every extra ball orbits the main one and is slightly smaller.
After 30s the vortex drags enemies within 16 blocks for 4s, then deals 88 lightning damage. Learning needs advanced lightning/curse fragments; advanced insight is +192 then +144.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_wind: New Wind Spells: Windburst Step and Wind Burial Corridor
Windburst Step: intermediate movement, 2 s cast, 75 mana, 15 s cooldown. Gales wrap you for 8 seconds with +150% movement speed.
Touching a creature knocks it back 7 blocks, deals 15 wind damage and applies 8 s Wind Assault; the same enemy can only be hit once per second.
While Wind Assault lasts, every Swirl reaction on that creature deals an extra 48 explosion damage. The blast attaches no element, so it cannot chain into itself.
Wind Burial Corridor: advanced damage, 4.5 s cast, 170 mana, 38 s cooldown. Releases Wind Frenzy for 100 mana per second, up to 48 seconds.
During Wind Frenzy you gain +195% movement speed and -24% turning speed; every 0.4 s an air block within 4 blocks becomes an 8 s storm field, refreshed instead of stacked.
At most 3 storm fields per caster; creatures inside are slashed once per second for 8 wind damage and Slowness II for one second, each hit adding 1 Wind Burial stack to the caster.
Press the cast key again: step back 3 blocks and swing a wind cross slash, 15 blocks long, 5 blocks wide, 108 wind damage, cutting up to 64 blocks below obsidian hardness.

Creatures hit by the cross slash share the Wind Burial stacks as total slashes: one every 2 ticks for 16 damage, with only 45% of the target resistances applying (ignoring 55% of all resistances). Stacks cap at 1024.
Windburst Step needs intermediate wind/movement fragments; Wind Burial needs advanced wind/destruction. Intermediate insight is +96 then +64; advanced +192 then +144.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_eart: New Earth Spells: Boulder and Myriad Meteors
Boulder: intermediate protection, 2.5 s cast, 85 mana, 40 s cooldown. Pick up to 3 targets (including yourself) and grant each a 28 s stone shell.
The shell has 100 health, grants +20 armor and +12 toughness, absorbs damage for the target, and makes it immune to knockback while it lasts.
Myriad Meteors: advanced destruction, 2 s cast, 350 mana, 9 s base cooldown. Three boulders rise from the ground around the caster and hover for 12 s.
During the hover, hold Alt and left-click to add a boulder for 85 mana, up to 45 extra (48 total). Each addition adds 2 s to the cooldown.
After 12 s the boulders launch along your crosshair, up to 64 blocks. A creature under the crosshair is targeted first; otherwise each boulder lands within 10 blocks of the crosshair.
Boulders never shatter in mid-air. They resolve only on a creature or on the ground: each landing blows a radius-3 crater that breaks blocks below hardness 6.

Each boulder deals 100 earth damage to creatures within 3 blocks, and each landing has a 30% chance to spray 2-6 small rocks dealing 8 earth damage. Pressing the cast key again stops the summon early and launches the raised boulders.
Learning: Boulder needs 1 medium earth fragment and 1 medium protection school fragment; Myriad Meteors needs 1 advanced earth fragment and 1 advanced destruction school fragment.
Boulder uses intermediate insight (+96 first, then +64); Myriad Meteors advanced (+192 then +144). When the shell breaks, armor, toughness and knockback immunity end together.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_fire: New Fire Spells: Flame Cage and Blazing Sun
Flame Cage: intermediate control, 2.5s cast, 90 mana, 18s cooldown. Target within 16 blocks; a radius-3 cage lasts 12s at the target's position.
Enemies inside cannot leave. Each second they take 6 fire damage and gain 20s Fire Vulnerability (+35% fire damage taken). The cage edge has 20 health.
Water or ice damage chips the cage's health. When it breaks, every enemy inside takes 15 fire damage.
Blazing Sun: advanced destruction, 5.5s cast, 150 mana, 45s cooldown. Base fireball radius 1, explosion radius 5, range 30, speed 24 blocks/s.
Once formed, hold Alt and left-click to charge: 90 mana per layer, up to 18 layers. Press cast again to launch; it fires automatically after 30s.
Each layer adds +0.2x fireball radius, +0.25x critical damage, +0.35x explosion radius and +1 range, but reduces launch speed by 12%.

The fireball destroys blocks on its path, turns nearby stone into lava that hardens into blackstone after 10s, sets fire within 3 blocks, detonates early on obsidian-level hardness and carries creatures while burning them for 16 per second.
The final blast destroys terrain up to radius 12 (obsidian-tier survives), vaporizes fluids and deals critical fire damage. It needs advanced fire/destruction fragments; insight is +192 then +144.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.basics.l: Right-click this book for the guide; press %s for skills, spells, and status.
Mana powers spells and regenerates naturally; ambient concentration changes its regeneration rate.

Battle Qi is an outer damage-reduction layer consumed before ordinary defenses. If one hit or a skill cost drains it to 0, you enter Battle Qi Collapse for 4 s: +25% damage taken from all sources and -45% melee damage dealt.
Sleeping immediately restores 50% maximum mana without exceeding the normal maximum.
Reaching zero mana causes exhaustion: no natural regeneration, more damage taken, and less damage dealt.
Potions can grant overcharge mana; unsafe overload poisons you and excess mana decays each second.
The lower-left orb shows mana and its outer ring shows battle qi; position and text scale are configurable.
Administrators can use /dimensional_mana help for mana, battle qi, and maximum-value commands.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.crystals: Grades are Lesser, Medium, Advanced, Supreme, and Special.
Finished crystals contain 100, 400, 1600, 4000, and 12000 mana respectively.
Most grades require mining and refining; Silk Touch blocks and the Special cluster itself can also be smelted into their crystal in any furnace, blast furnace, mana forge, or professional furnace.
Crystal ores generate underground and are denser in mana crystal caves, which can contain rare Special clusters.
A finished crystal can be ground into four dust of the same grade.
Any grinder makes 6 Lapis Dust or 2 Amethyst Dust at its Lesser Crystal processing time.
Crystal dust is used in potions, processor reconstruction, and magical devices.
Pure Liquid Mana makes Basalt from flowing lava and Crying Obsidian from source lava.
Drinking Pure Liquid Mana restores 300% maximum mana but causes Wither for 180 seconds.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.furnaces: Mana Forge recipe: eight Crying Obsidian surrounding one Medium Mana Crystal.
Professional recipe: Nether Star, Glass, Advanced Crystal, Netherite Ingot, Mana Forge, two Lapis Blocks, and two Amethyst Blocks.
Both machines use ordinary fuel and support standard smelting recipes from Minecraft and other mods.
Standard recipes take 80% furnace time in the Mana Forge and 30% in the Professional Furnace.
Professional: Lesser Crystal to Medium Dust in 4 seconds.
Professional: Medium Crystal to Advanced Dust in 6 seconds.
Professional: Advanced Crystal to Supreme Dust in 12 seconds.
Professional: Supreme Crystal to Special Dust in 24 seconds.

Place the back of the furnace (the side without the lit mouth) against a crystal processor to link them: smelted items stop giving experience and instead charge the processor; see the Furnace Link page.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.processo: Recipe: three Iron Ingots on top, a Diamond Pestle in the center, and any five Planks elsewhere.
Put finished crystals in the fuel slot; each digests for 5 seconds. Capacity is 20000 mana.
The five grades supply 100, 400, 1600, 4000, and 12000 mana.
4 Lesser Dust + Lapis Dust makes a Lesser Crystal and returns Lapis Dust; 4 seconds, 20 mana.
4 Medium Dust + Amethyst Dust makes a Medium Crystal and returns Amethyst Dust; 4 seconds, 120 mana.
4 Advanced Dust + Medium Dust makes an Advanced Crystal and returns Lesser Dust; 4 seconds, 550 mana.
4 Supreme Dust + Advanced Dust makes a Supreme Crystal and returns Medium Dust; 4 seconds, 2000 mana.
4 Special Dust + Supreme Dust makes a Special Crystal and returns Advanced Dust; 4 seconds, 5000 mana.

Fragment upgrade (element/school/arcane): lower fragment + 3 next-grade mana dust + 1 amethyst dust + 2 lapis dust; returns 3 lower-grade mana dust and 1 lapis dust. The four upgrades take 4/6/8/10 seconds and cost 50/220/840/2080 mana.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.grinding: Process one finished crystal in a grinder to produce four matching dust.
Wooden Grinder: Bowl and Stick, 20 durability, Lesser grade only.
Stone Grinder: three Stone and a Stone Pestle, 120 durability, up to Medium.
Golden Grinder: three Gold Ingots and a Gold Pestle, 40 durability, fast and up to Medium.
Iron Grinder: three Iron Ingots and an Iron Pestle, 400 durability, up to Advanced.
Diamond Grinder: three Diamonds and a Diamond Pestle, 1200 durability, up to Supreme.
Upgrade the Diamond Grinder by smithing to get 2400 durability and support every grade.
Make Stone, Iron, Gold, and Diamond Pestles from matching material blocks in a Stonecutter.
Brewing Stand: Thick Potion + Lesser Crystal Dust makes a Mana Harmonizer.
Lesser potion: Glass Bottle, Lesser Dust, Lapis, Glowstone Dust, and Harmonizer.
Medium potion: Glass Bottle, Medium Dust, Lapis, Glowstone Dust, and Harmonizer.
Advanced potion: Glass Bottle, Advanced Dust, Amethyst, Glowstone Dust, and Harmonizer.
Special potion: Glass Bottle, Supreme Dust, Amethyst, Glowstone Dust, and Harmonizer.
Crafting returns the Harmonizer bottle and drinking also leaves a Glass Bottle.
Higher grades restore more mana and may exceed the normal maximum as overcharge.
Craft bottled Pure Liquid Mana from its bucket and a Glass Bottle; it is powerful but dangerous.
Brewing Stand: Potion of Poison II + Special Mana Crystal Dust makes a Potion of Poison III (Poison III, 18s).
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.explorat: Appraisal Orb: Amethyst Block and four Medium Crystals; right-click to inspect yourself.
Mana Detector: Appraisal Orb, Redstone Dust, Quartz, Glass, and Observer.
Charge the detector for 3 seconds and spend 10 mana to see concentration and the nearest known cave.
Appraisal Glasses: Appraisal Orb, two Glass Panes, and two Gold Ingots; equip in a head slot.
The glasses show concentration and target health, mana, battle qi, or mana content near the crosshair.
The glasses consume 0.4 mana each second and stop working without mana.
Average concentration is 10 Overworld, 8 Nether, and 1 End, with smooth changes inside a biome.
Amethyst geodes have at least 12 concentration and mana crystal caves at least 15.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.enchantm: Battle Qi Coating goes on armor and adds a percentage of current total battle qi per level, up to IV.
Battle Qi Coating I book: Glowstone Dust, Book, Medium Mana Crystal, and Lapis.
Battle Qi Breaker goes on weapons and ignores part of the target's battle qi by level, up to V.
Battle Qi Breaker I book: Gunpowder, Book, Medium Mana Crystal, and Lapis.
Combine matching enchanted books in an Anvil for higher levels.
The orb, detector, glasses, furnaces, and processor use ordinary Crafting Table recipes.
The recipe book and JEI show normal data recipes; both custom furnaces also appear as smelting machines.
Name colors show rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic in increasing order.
Goblin Slayer goes on weapons: +20% damage to goblins per level, up to V. A level I book is Goblin Clan Crest + Book, 100 mana, 4 seconds.
Slime Slayer goes on weapons: +20% damage to slimes (elemental, vanilla, magma) per level, up to V. A level I book is any 5 elemental crystal dusts + Slimeball + Book, 100 mana, 4 seconds.
Book upgrade: place the book in the processor center with one mana dust in each of the 8 outer slots; enchantments at that grade go up 1 level. 8 seconds.
Lesser/Medium/Advanced/Supreme/Special dust moves 1->2, 2->3, 3->4, 4->5 and 5->6, costing 20/50/120/270/580 mana; vanilla enchanted books work too.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.progress: Magic level runs from 0 to 15; you start with 6 skill points and gain more by leveling.
Mana, battle qi, resistance, power, haste, crit chance, crit damage, and cost reduction each have 20 ranks, with the same per-rank scaling.
Ranks 1-3 cost 1 point, 4-6 cost 2, 7-9 cost 3, and 10-20 cost 4.
Basic/intermediate/advanced spells grant 1/2/3 points; every 3 new spells grant 3 more.
After level 15, extra magic experience converts to vanilla experience.
Actually reaching zero mana can roll exhaustion growth up to four times per day.
Repentance Stone recipe: Special Mana Crystal and Ghast Tear.
Hold right-click to spend 200 mana and refund every allocated skill point.
Hover status entries to inspect base values, permanent growth, and temporary equipment or effect modifiers.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.achievem: Open Advancements (L by default) to find two main trees: Arcane Enlightenment and Element Reactions.
The enlightenment tree covers the Codex of Myriad Arts, magic levels 1/5/10/15, and the six mana milestones 200/500/1000/2000/5000/10000.
Skill achievements: spend your first skill point, max any skill to 20, and start all eight skills.
Accessory achievements: first accessory, all 12 elemental rings, the Element Enhance Ring, casting gloves, three cloaks, amulets and the Resonance Core.
Material and crafting achievements: any mana crystal, Superconducting Crystal Dust, Superconducting Crystal, Ancient Magic Steel Billet and Poison III.
Staff achievements: any general staff and the Special General Staff.
Mechanic achievements: toggle the orb switch, first Adventurer trade, a legendary trade, and all five trade tiers.
Achievements are stored per server world; on a multiplayer server every player tracks their own.
The Codex of Myriad Arts starts the enlightenment tree: you receive it on first join and it holds every rule and recipe.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.adventur: Adventurers appear near villages and can also be summoned with a spawn egg. Right-click one to open trading.
Each refresh offers 10 trades: T1 40% (about 4), T2 30% (about 3), T3 20% (about 2), T4 8% (about 1) and T5 2% (about 0-1).
Every offer shows two price slots followed by the result; the border color marks its tier.
Click the result to buy. Missing materials or sold-out offers show a red hint and the villager's refusal sound.
Uses per offer: T1 5-8, T2 4-6, T3 2-4, T4 1-2, T5 1.
Once an Adventurer settles in a village, the pool rerolls and uses reset every in-game day (24000 ticks).
A successful trade grants a little vanilla experience, more for higher tiers.
While you browse, the Adventurer stands still; walking more than 8 blocks away closes the screen.
Related achievements: First Bargain, Legendary Purchase, Five-Tier Merchant.

gui.dimensional_mana.spell.blazing_sun.s: Advanced · 5.5s cast · 150 mana · 90 mana per charge · 55 critical damage · explosion radius 5 · range 30 · 45s cooldown

gui.dimensional_mana.spell.abyss_dragon_: Unfolds a water dragon sigil and fires a 36-block high-pressure jet that pierces every enemy in its path: 48 water damage on contact, then 20 water damage every 0.5s that refreshes the water attachment and pushes targets back 0.5 blocks. Jet damage ignores the target's invulnerability frames, so every 0.5s pulse always lands in full. Once the jet has touched a block for 1s it keeps blasting every block within a 2-block radius, another batch every 0.5s, tunnelling deeper; anything harder than 3 stops it, and flowers, grass and leaves are simply washed away. Lava it touches becomes obsidian (still) or cobblestone (flowing), and fire is snuffed out first. While firing you move 50% slower, cannot jump and turn at most 30 degrees per second; it drains 4.5 mana per tick and pressing cast again stops it.
Advanced · 5s cast · 190 mana · 48 initial damage · 20 water damage per 0.5s · range 36 · diameter about 1.35 · 4.5 mana per tick · up to 30s · -50% move speed · 40s cooldown (after the jet ends)
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.ice_golem.des: Summons a Frost Golem with a translucent ice body and a carved pumpkin head. It stands its ground and fires an ice spike at nearby enemies every 3 seconds, up to 10 shots before shattering. Each player can have at most 4 at once.

gui.dimensional_mana.spell.subzero_domai: After the cast, an advanced ice sigil unfolds around you. Hold Alt and left-click to stack up to 12 layers (144 mana each), then press cast again to release a freezing domain: water becomes blue ice, lava becomes basalt, exposed ground is covered with snow, and enemies inside take 55 ice damage and are always frozen (targets above the health limit are frozen for half the duration). Frozen targets refresh their ice attachment every 4s, take extra damage and extra elemental reaction damage, and only break free after 4 direct attacks.
Advanced · 9s cast · 155 mana · 55 ice damage · radius 12 · 20s freeze · 144 mana per layer · up to 12 layers · 45s cooldown
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.volt_state.de: Lightning wraps your body for 12 seconds: +200% movement speed, +50% jump height, -50% damage taken, and every 0.5 s you shock any enemy touching you for 10 lightning damage with lightning attachment. Shocks ignore invulnerability frames.
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.volt_state.st: Intermediate · 2.5 s cast · 120 mana · 12 s · +200% speed · +50% jump · -50% damage taken · 10 lightning per 0.5 s · 30 s cooldown
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.thunder_tempe: During the cast, stacked sigil rings form overhead and a huge ball lightning spins above them. For 30 seconds the ball follows the caster and strikes up to three random enemies within 9 blocks every 0.4 s for 8 lightning damage with lightning attachment (ignores armour, spell resistance and invulnerability frames; leaves a 1 s lightning afterimage). Each hit has a 55% chance to inflict 15 s Polarity Disorder (subsequent hits have a 25% chance to refresh it): the victim takes +34% damage with no invulnerability frames and deals -42% damage. Hold Alt + left click while casting to add up to two smaller balls for 555 mana each. When the 30 seconds end the ball collapses into an electromagnetic vortex that drags enemies within 16 blocks for 4 seconds before exploding for 88 lightning damage.
Advanced · 15 s cast · 550 mana · 30 s · 8 lightning per 0.4 s · up to 3 targets · 9 block range · 15 s Polarity Disorder · +555 mana x2 · 88 explosion damage · 120 s cooldown
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.wind_burst_st: Gales wrap your body for 8 seconds: +150% movement speed. Touching a creature knocks it back 7 blocks, deals 15 wind damage and applies 8 s Wind Assault. While Wind Assault lasts, every Swirl reaction on that creature deals an extra 48 explosion damage.
Intermediate · 2 s cast · 75 mana · 8 s · +150% speed · 7 block knockback · 15 wind damage · 8 s Wind Assault · 15 s cooldown
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.wind_burial_c: The cast ends in Wind Frenzy: 100 mana per second for up to 48 seconds, +195% movement speed and -24% turning speed. Every 0.4 s an air block within 4 blocks becomes an 8 s storm field (refreshed rather than stacked, at most 3 per caster). Creatures inside are slashed once per second for 8 wind damage plus Slowness II for one second, and each hit adds 1 Wind Burial stack to the caster. Pressing the cast key again steps you back 3 blocks and swings a wind cross slash: 15 blocks long, 5 blocks wide, 108 wind damage, cutting up to 64 blocks below obsidian hardness. Creatures hit share the Wind Burial stacks as total slashes, one every 2 ticks for 16 damage that ignores 55% of all resistances. Stacks cap at 1024 and the 38 s cooldown starts when the cross slash is released.

Advanced · 4.5 s cast · 170 mana · 100 mana per second · up to 48 s · +195% speed · -24% turning · 8 s storm fields x3 · 8 wind damage per second · 108 cross slash · 64 blocks cut · 16 per Wind Burial stack · 1024 stack cap · 38 s cooldown (after release)
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.boulder.descr: Pick up to 3 targets (including yourself) and give each a 28 s stone shell: 100 shell health, +20 armor, +12 toughness, absorbing damage for the target. While the shell lasts the target is immune to knockback; if the shell breaks, the effect ends early.
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.boulder.stats: Intermediate · 2.5 s cast · 85 mana · up to 3 targets · 100 shell health · +20 armor · +12 toughness · 28 s · knockback immunity · 40 s cooldown
gui.dimensional_mana.spell.myriad_meteor: Three boulders rise from the ground around you and hover for 12 s. Hold Alt and left-click to spend 85 mana per extra boulder, up to 45 extra (48 total); each addition adds 2 s to the cooldown. The boulders then launch along your crosshair, up to 64 blocks, self-correcting their arc. A creature under the crosshair is prioritized; otherwise each lands within 10 blocks of the crosshair. A boulder never shatters in mid-air: it resolves only when it hits a creature or reaches the ground. Every landing blows a radius-3 crater, breaking blocks below hardness 6 and dealing 100 earth damage to creatures within 3 blocks. Each landing also has a 30% chance to spray 2-6 small rocks that deal 8 earth damage on contact. Press the cast key again to stop the summon early and launch the boulders already raised.

Advanced · 2 s cast · 350 mana · 3 base boulders · 85 mana per extra (max 45) · 100 damage each · 64 block range · radius-3 crater on landing · 30% chance of 2-6 debris · 9 s cooldown (+2 s per extra)

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.magic_sy: Each spell combines a school and a medium: the school decides what it does, while the medium decides the form of energy.
For example, Destruction + Arcane creates pure magic damage; Healing + Water suits restoration and cleansing.
A school is not an element. Fire may power damage, protection, blessing, or summoning spells.
A medium does not decide purpose alone. The same arcane power can form a ray, ward, or recovery enhancement.
Basic media are tangible natural forms; advanced media are abstract and usually require deeper knowledge.
English configuration tags identify data rules. Players normally only need the localized name and icon.
There are 50 spells: 36 basic (3 of them arcane), 12 intermediate and 2 advanced.
Other schools and media are classified but not yet castable, and will be added gradually.
Thirteen Schools: What a Spell Does
Destruction (破, destruction): direct damage, breaking, and burst.
Protection (守, protection): barriers, reduction, and blocking.
Healing (愈, healing): recovery, cleansing, and resurrection.
Blessing (祝, blessing): beneficial effects and enhancements.
Curse (咒, curse): harmful statuses and weakening.
Control (缚, control): rooting, slowing, and stunning.
Summoning (召, summon): summoned creatures, servants, and pacts.
Movement (迁, movement): teleporting, acceleration, and jumping.
Divination (窥, divination): detection, warning, and revelation.
Psychic (心, psychic): mental damage and manipulation.
Time (时, time): acceleration, slowing, and reversal.
Space (空, space): transport, spatial cuts, and folding.
Chaos (虚, chaos): randomness, disorder, and annihilation.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.media.li: Basic Fire (fire) favors burst and burning. Water (water) favors flow, healing, and impact.
Basic Ice (ice) slows and freezes. Lightning (lightning) chains and paralyzes.
Basic Wind (wind) moves and cuts. Earth (earth) defends and shocks.
Basic Nature (nature) heals, summons, and entangles. Metal (metal) sharpens, armors, and arms.
Basic Light (light) is pure light. Poison (poison) deals damage over time and weakens. Sound (sound) vibrates, affects minds, and controls.
Advanced Holy (holy) joins light and faith and works with every school. Arcane (arcane) is versatile, unattributed pure magic.
Advanced Time, Space, and Psychic also correspond to schools of the same names.
Advanced Chaos (chaos) may behave as every element, no element, or unpredictable chaotic power.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.element_: Element Resonance and Novice Spell Access
The first time you open the Arcane Codex, choose three different novice elements for Element Resonance.
Arcane is always available and does not use one of the three choices. Each unlocked element reveals its three novice spells and one intermediate spell.
Starting a novice elemental spell requires one matching Lesser Element Fragment and one matching Lesser School Fragment. Cast it successfully three times to master it.
Locked elements become available after researching the matching ancient magic or using an Element Talent Scroll.
Unlocked elements remain available unless you reset your resonance with an Element Resonance Stone.
Element Unlocks, Resetting, and Targeted Casting
Element Talent Scrolls have a combined 0.005% chance to appear in vanilla chests. Use one to unlock its element permanently.
Successfully recombining a Special Mana Crystal in the processor has a 0.5% chance to create a random Element Talent Scroll.
An Element Resonance Stone costs a Special Mana Crystal, Nether Star, and Ghast Tear. It consumes 500 mana and refunds 50% of invested fragments.
For targeted spells, press Cast, right-click a target to mark it, then left-click to confirm. Press Cast again to cancel for free.
Fragments are divided into element, school, and arcane families, each with Lesser, Medium, Advanced, Supreme, and Special grades.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.attachment.hi: The same element refreshes the longer duration; combinations without a reaction coexist.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.reaction: Element spells leave visible attachments. Reapplying an element keeps the longer duration. A target can react only once per 0.5 seconds.
Short attachments: Sound 3s, Light 4.2s, Lightning 5s, Wind 5.5s. Two short attachments are both consumed by a reaction.
Long attachments: Metal 7s, Ice 8s, Nature 10s, Poison 10.5s, Fire 10.8s, Earth 11s, Water 20s.
Short + long consumes the short and keeps 50% of the long. Long + long consumes the shorter and keeps 80% of the other.
Burning and poison ticks refresh their long attachments. Combinations without a reaction simply coexist.
Wind reacts with every other element as Swirl. Advancements record each reaction you personally trigger.
Amplifying and Transformative Reactions
%s (Fire + Water): direct damage %s; %s (Fire + Ice): direct damage %s.
Overload (Fire + Lightning) explodes for 250% of the hit in a 3-block radius and knocks creatures away.
Electro-Charged (Water + Lightning) chains 24% lightning damage to up to five water-attached targets within 8 blocks, losing 10% each jump.
Superconduct (Ice + Lightning) deals ×1.5 damage and reduces physical resistance by 50% for 8 seconds; below zero becomes vulnerability.
Catalyze (Nature + Lightning) multiplies this hit by 1.4.
Freeze (Water + Ice) immobilizes for 6 seconds and grants +50% vulnerability to Fire.
Persistent and Spreading Reactions
Burning (Fire + Nature) deals 4 spell damage each second for 6 seconds.
Corruption (Nature + Poison) extends and strengthens poison for 6 seconds.
Swirl (Wind + any element) spreads the other attachment within 5 blocks without extra damage.
Mire (Water + Earth) reduces movement by 60% and jumping by 50% for 5 seconds.
Spread (Water + Nature) spreads Nature within 2 blocks once per second for 3 seconds.
Secondary Element Reactions
Smelt (Fire + Metal) reduces armor by 40% for 6 seconds.
Purify (Light + Poison) clears poison and increases the Light hit by remaining poison seconds, up to +230%.
Shockwave (Lightning + Sound) chains 15% sound damage to up to five nearby targets.
Blind (Light + Fire) blinds for 3 seconds and gives attacks a 50% miss chance.
Direct Light damage deals 30% more to undead. This is an element trait and requires no reaction.
Unlisted combinations among Metal, Water, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Nature, Light, Poison, and Sound coexist without reacting.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.new_pois: New Poison Spells: Venom Heart and Zhen Plume Night
Venom Heart: intermediate damage, 3 s cast, 110 mana, 20 s cooldown. After the cast you dash 2 blocks forward and fire a poison needle from your eyes.
The needle flies 3.5 blocks per tick for up to 70 blocks and pierces at most 7 enemies; every enemy hit takes 14 poison damage and gains poison attachment.

Zhen Plume Night: advanced debuff, 5.5 s cast, 140 mana. The mist starts at a 3 block radius for 30 s and stays centred where you cast it.

Zhen Poison: poisoning an already poisoned enemy refreshes the poison and adds 1 layer. Each layer gives 4% additive poison vulnerability and -1% movement speed, up to 50 layers, 60 s duration refreshed on every stack.

While Zhen Poison lasts all healing is halved; every poison damage hit has a 15% chance to shave 0.55% of max health (restored when Zhen Poison ends, lost health is not healed back); light damage taken also deals 30% poison damage without attachment, once per 10 ticks.

The 55 s cooldown only starts when the mist has fully faded. The poison and Zhen Poison from the mist are forced: milk, honey, totems and other cleansing cannot remove them. Learning: medium poison fragment + medium destruction school fragment; advanced poison fragment + advanced curse school fragment.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.element_: Elemental Plating
Put one piece of armor or a shield in the centre of the crystal processor and one matching element crystal powder in each of the other eight slots.
Armor plating costs 200 mana and 15 seconds; shield plating costs only 40 mana and 5 seconds, so you can swap it between bosses.
Each item holds at most 4 layers, at most 4 of one element, and layers can be mixed, for example 2 flame + 2 frost.
Each armor layer grants 5% damage resistance to that element, covering spells, lava/fire, freezing and lightning; four pieces at 4 layers each reach the 80% cap.
Cost: every layer makes that armor piece lose 1 extra durability when it takes damage of that element.

Each shield layer gives a 25% chance to perfectly block that element, so 4 layers mean full immunity; vanilla shields already stop ordinary elemental hits, so plating matters most against damage that pierces shields.
Elemental erosion: blocking that element always costs (damage / 10 + 1) x layers extra durability, so big hits hurt the shield fast.
A vanilla grindstone strips all plating and enchantments, returning 1-2 matching element crystal powders per layer.
Plated items show a prefix like [Flame Plating I], and the tooltip lists resistance, block chance and durability cost.
Perfect blocks flash an elemental shield effect, and plated armor glimmers in the element colour when it takes that element.
gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.furnace_: Put the crystal processor directly behind the mana forge or professional furnace (the back is the side opposite the burning mouth) and it links up: purple mana drifts out of the back into the processor.
While linked, smelted items give no vanilla experience; they are converted into mana and poured straight into the attached processor.
Mana forge: 1 mana for any ordinary product; 25 / 100 / 400 / 1000 / 4000 for lesser / medium / advanced / supreme / special crystals.
Professional furnace: 3 mana for any ordinary product; 50 / 200 / 800 / 2000 / 8000 for lesser / medium / advanced / supreme / special crystals.
The processor holds at most 20000 mana; anything beyond that is wasted, so keep an eye on its charge.
Without the link, smelting still grants experience: the mana forge gives 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 XP for lesser / medium / advanced / supreme crystals.
The professional furnace gives 1.5 / 3 / 4.5 / 6 XP for those crystals; orbs are whole numbers, so the fraction is rolled into an extra orb.
Break the processor or turn the furnace around to end the link, and taking results grants experience again.

Silk Touch ore blocks and the Special cluster can be smelted too: the mana forge gives 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 XP and the professional furnace 1.5 / 3 / 4.5 / 6 / 7.5 XP for lesser to special; linking still converts them into mana.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.mob_comb: Mob Mana, Battle Qi and Skills
Since 1.2.0 every vanilla mob has two resources: Mana and Battle Qi. Friendly mobs get 0.8 x max health Mana and 0.35 x max health Battle Qi, refilled once per in-game day.
Hostile and neutral mobs scale with difficulty: Peaceful 0.5x health; Easy 0.8x+100; Normal 1.1x+300; Hard 1.4x+500. Battle Qi uses the same shape and regenerates per second.
All mob Mana regeneration is tied to the dimension and chunk's ambient mana concentration: the End is the slowest, caves and rich areas the fastest.

Combat uses 12 elements: arcane, metal, wood, water, fire, earth, ice, lightning, poison, sound, light and wind. Mob resistances and weaknesses apply on every difficulty by default, and physical/explosion damage also uses the all resistance; turn on resistances_hard_only to limit them to Hard.
Running out of Mana causes Mana Exhaustion and blocks casting; running out of Battle Qi causes Battle Qi Collapse and blocks Battle-Qi skills. Both recover only after the status ends.
Below half health the Wither casts Wither Storm: 16-block black fog dealing arcane damage and draining 20% of nearby creatures' current Mana.
Ender Dragon breath may mutate: a bigger cloud that leaves an anti-magic zone where Mana regeneration is zero, casting is blocked, and ongoing spells and buffs are stripped.
A Blaze whose Battle Qi breaks erupts in a fire nova; Ghasts may fire high-pressure fireballs; Piglin Brutes sunder armour and empty your Battle Qi; Zombified Piglins gain attack speed when hit.

Endermen teleport with brief invulnerability when their Battle Qi breaks; closed Shulkers spend Battle Qi for 99% physical resistance; Witches spend Mana to halve physical damage; Evokers explode on death.

Trial Chambers: Breeze wind charges stack Magic Retort (each stack adds 1 second of cast wind-up, up to 10); Bogged arrows slow your Mana regeneration; Ravagers and Vindicators ignore part of your armour.

Iron Golems stun with precise strikes, Wardens mark you with their sonic boom, and Elder Guardians apply Ancient Curse. Every value is editable in config/dimensional_mana-mobs.toml, including stacked vs independent mode; old saves keep their values.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.relics.l: Creatures crit: every melee hit rolls a critical based on world difficulty - Peaceful 0%, Easy 5%, Normal 10%, Hard 15%, with 1.0/1.25/1.5/1.75x damage.
The roll happens before armor, resistance and battle-qi reduction, so a crit is a stronger hit rather than damage that bypasses defense; particles and sound can be disabled separately.
Players follow the same rules: vanilla jump crits still work and flat-ground melee can crit too; set player_attacks_can_crit to false to opt out.
All numbers live in config/dimensional_mana-critical.toml, one block per difficulty; disabling enabled turns the whole system off and leaves only the accessory stats.
The new accessories come in four tiers: t0 gold and bold with glint, t1 purple and bold, t2 aqua, t3 green; rarity drops with the tier.
The Bloodthirst Brooch uses the Chest slot (body) on its own; cloaks only go in the back slot. The Universal Belt opens one more universal accessory slot that accepts any relic.
Stat accessories use real Curios attribute modifiers: Green Amber Ring +25% speed, Bloodthirst Brooch -25% max health, Aurora -35% max health, Seal Blindfold +35% spell crit and -50% max mana.
Right-click the Ring of Choice while holding it to flip modes: 1 deals 1.25x and takes 1.35x, 2 takes 0.5x and deals 0.75x; the tooltip shows the current mode.
The Omniscient Shard absorbs two fatal hits; once both are used it shatters and grants 1000 vanilla experience.
The strong ones cost something: the Bloodthirst Brooch steals 15% of all damage as health but halves healing, and the Seal Blindfold doubles crit power at half mana capacity.
Six are crafted in the Crystal Processor: Bracelet of Release, Mage's Delight, Universal Belt, Scarlet Spirit Charm, Angel Crown and Omniscient Shard; recipe seconds are ticks divided by 20.

The rest come from chests, mob drops and rare adventurer trades: a rare-tier adventurer always sells one Detective Charm for 16 supreme mana crystals, and the Smuggler's Ring halves villager and adventurer prices.
Tier only sets rarity, name color and glint: t0 gold and bold with enchantment glint, t1 bold purple, t2 aqua, t3 green.

gui.dimensional_mana.guide.page.battle_q: Stance: hold right-click for 5 ticks (0.25 s) with a sword in the main hand and an empty off hand. The view dips slightly and gold brackets appear under the crosshair; above 50% battle qi the blade glows. Release right-click or switch items to leave the stance.
Stance bonus: all incoming damage -10%, but every hit that lands costs the main-hand sword 1 durability.
Deflect: press left-click while in the stance. 8-tick (0.4 s) cooldown, one target per press.
Projectile deflect: hostile arrows, fireballs and magic bolts within 3.6 blocks shatter for 2 battle qi; each has its own debris particles and breaking sound.
Melee deflect: an enemy melee hit within 3 blocks arriving in the 12 ticks (0.6 s) after your press is stopped; hits arriving within the first 5 ticks (0.25 s) count as a perfect parry.

Cost: a successful deflect spends battle qi equal to the monster's attack damage. Not enough qi means the parry fails - you eat the hit, lose all battle qi and get a 4 s Battle Qi Collapse (25% extra damage taken, -45% melee).

Normal parry: no damage, no qi refund, the monster keeps attacking. Perfect parry: interrupts the monster and stuns it for 1 s, refunds 1.5x the qi spent (half of it is profit). Overflow above the cap becomes 2 s of Speed II.

Feel: normal parries clang with sparks and a white crosshair ring; perfect parries burst into a golden cross shockwave with a screen flash and vignette; running out of qi gives a glass shatter and a red screen edge.
